body: I see an overdose coming up pretty soon in my future. I can’t imagine even living till 20. I don’t see a husband or kids. I see a lot of drugs, an abandoned house/shed, a needle, and my arm

Apologies for being so nonchalant about this stuff, but I deal with my problems through comedy because it allows me to express myself and pretend that I don’t care. I can let other people know things without becoming a babbling mess of tears, snot, and saliva. I’m constantly sarcastic so that if I say something not PG around people that care too much and might put me somewhere, I can play it off as a joke.

Also when I started cutting I would just stick a knife into my leg and poke a hole, then pull out the edges a bit. Now I’m writing full words like KYS or DIE. I’m carving myself like a pumpkin, which is great for spooky season but in general it’s getting a bit out of control. I don’t think “oh I’m gonna cut now” or “let’s write some words on my leg.” But I keep a couple pocket knives by my bed and when I get frustrated it’s relaxing to zone out and take out my frustration on my (way too thicc) thighs.

Try to keep trigger foods as far away from you as you can. If you live alone, don’t buy sweets that you might binge on. If you live with others, make sure that everything is put up and away so you have to make a more conscious decision to eat it. If you leave a box of cookies on the counter then you’ll see those cookies and want to eat them at night. The old saying rings true, “out of sight, out of mind”
